DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

                                                       

 

                                                       

SPECIMEN                           :   Gall bladder.

 

 

 

 

GROSS FINDINGS                :   Gall bladder measured 5.7 cm in length.

                                                      Cystic lymph node identified.

 

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :  Sections show features of chronic cholecystitis.

                                                     Section from the lymph node show reactive changes.

 

                                                    No malignant changes seen.

 

 

 

 

IMPRESSION                       : 1) CHRONIC CHOLECYSTITIS.

                                                 2) REACTIVE CHANGES-LYMPH NODE.

 

 

 

ENCLOSED                          :  Two slides

                                                     (SDC/AA/00 A & B/18)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOLOGY

 

 

 Specimen :  Uterus, Cervix and Bilateral Adnexa.

 

 

 Gross :  7 x 3 x 3 cm. specimen of uterus, cervix and bilateral adnexa. Uterus measures 4 cm  

                in length. There are multiple intramural, sub mucus fibroids measuring 2-5 cm in 

                diameter. Cervix measures 3 cm in length and appears unremarkable/ shows few 

                nabothian follicles. Right ovary measures 3 x 2 cm. and appears unremarkable/appears

                partly solid and partly cystic. Left ovary measures 3 x 2 cm. and appears

                unremarkable/appears partly solid partly cystic. Both tubes measures 5cm in length

                and appear unremarkable.

 

 

 Microscopy :  Multiple sections confirm the benign nature of leiomyoma. The endometrium is

                          non secretory/ proliferative with foci of adenomyosis.

 

                          The endometrial glands are seen insinuating deep into myometrium. Cervix shows  

                          features of chronic non specific cervicitis/ is unremarkable. Right ovary is

                          unremarkable. Left ovary is unremarkable. Both tubes are unremarkable.

 

                          No evidence of any invasive malignancy.

 

 

 Diagnosis : Composite specimen of Uterus, cervix and bilateral adnexa→1.Adenomyosis,

                      2.Leiomyoma, 3.Follicular cyst of right ovary.

 

 

IMPRESSION  : 

 

 

 

ENCLOSED  :  Four slides and blocks.

                         (SDC/AA/00 A to D/24)

 

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOPATHOLOGY

                                                      

Chronic cholecystitis

 

 

SPECIMEN  :   Gall bladder.

 

 

 

GROSS FINDINGS  :   Already cut open Gall Bladder measuring (6.5 x 2.0) cm.

                                      Lumen is empty. Mucosa is non bile stained.

 

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :  Multiple sections studied show features of chronic        

                                                     cholecystitis.

 

                                                     No evidence of malignancy.

 

 

IMPRESSION : Gall Bladder → Chronic cholecystitis.

 

 

 

ENCLOSED                          :  Two slides and blocks.

                                                     (SDC/SB/64 A & B/25)

 

 

 

 

N.B: Remaining Specimen would be preserved for One month. (30 Days)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOPATHOLOGY

 

Acute on chronic calculous cholecystitis

 

 

SPECIMEN  :   Gall bladder.

 

 

 

 

GROSS FINDINGS  :   Gall bladder is already cut open and measuring (7.0 x 2.5 ) cm wall is

                                      thickened and lumen contains sludge and small brittle calculi.

                                      Mucosa non bile stained.

 

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :  Multiple sections studied show histological features of acute

                                                   on chronic calculous cholecystitis.

                                                    

 

                                                    No evidence of malignancy.

 

IMPRESSION :  Gallbladder → Acute on chronic calculous cholecystitis.

 

 

 

ENCLOSED   :  Two slides and blocks.

                         (SDC/SB/63 A & B/25)

 

 

 

N.B: Remaining Specimen would be preserved for One month. (30 Days)
